==Notes==
*Mesqul Ironhealer may not [[spawn]] in every [[instance]], since he shares five possible spawn locations in the Frozen Forest with five other bosses: [[Barl Stormsiege]], [[Boreal Kubeclaw]], [[Jollen Steelblight]], [[Linka Goldensteel]], and [[Resnar Mountainsight]].
